body:
duelRespond's accept path now mints a random 32-hex-char token (15-min TTL) on the duel_challenges row, surfaced identically to both participants via GET duels while unexpired, never on a decline. New additive migration (202609240400_duel_match_tokens.sql). New test coverage in game_social_test.go confirms the token round-trips correctly for both players and is absent on decline. go build/vet/test ./... clean. This is IDUNA's half only -- DEADWEIGHT's own matchmaking queue doesn't consume the token yet, that's Phase 2 of this same subsection. Commit 2716c8e.

⚓ ☃
title: Duel accept mints a shared match_token (S537 Duel Phase 2, Phase 1)
